content:
The Tenable Attack Path API enables users to retrieve details about attack path findings and attack
path vectors. A Finding is an attack technique that exists in one or more attack paths that lead to one
or more critical assets. The Findings tab in Attack Path Analysis takes your data and pairs it with
advanced graph analytics and the MITRE ATT&CK® Framework to create Findings, which enables
you to understand and act on the unknowns that enable and amplify threat impact on your assets
and information. For more information about findings, see Attack Path in the Tenable Exposure
Management User Guide.
|
